subject: maths
question: What is the curved surface area of a right circular cylinder of height 21 cm and radius 3 cm (use π = 22/7)?
solution:
**Given:**

Height (h) of the cylinder = 21 cm

Radius (r) of the cylinder = 3 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a right circular cylinder = 2 π r h

**Calculation:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 π r h

⇒ CSA = 2 × 22/7 × 3 × 21

⇒ CSA = (2 × 22 × 3 × 21)/7

⇒ CSA = 2772/7

⇒ CSA = 396 cm²

**The curved surface area of the cylinder is 396 cm².**
